en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Al Halby, from Abu Saeed Al Mukary, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [26:94] So they shall be flung into it, they and the erring ones.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They are a group who described justice with their tongues, then they opposed it to something else’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya al-Halabi from abu Sa‘id al-Mukari from abu Basir from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Imam abu Ja‘far (a.s.) has said about the words of Allah in the holy Quran, ‘The idol worshippers, the idols, the rebellious ones, [26:94] and the army of Satan will all be thrown headlong into hell. [26:95]’
They are the people who speak about justice a great deal but in their own practice they would disregard it altogether.’”
